sentences.text:
THE ATHIRAPPALLY GRAMA PANCHAYAT REPRESENTED BY ITS SECRETARY,
 VETTILAPPARA P.O., THRISSUR DISTRICT, PIN - 680721  Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to stay all further proceedings with respect to taking possession  of the petitioners property for the construction of Hill High way Reach -  III Vellikulangara to Vettilappara Bridge, pending disposal of the Writ Vinoy K.V vs State Of Kerala on 4 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125193726/
1  Petition (Civil), in the interest of justice.
 WP(C) No.20017/2024 2/4  This petition coming on for admission upon perusing the petition and  the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and upon hearing the arguments of  SRI.JOHN K.GEORGE, Advocate for the petitioners, the court passed the  following:
 WP(C) No.20017/2024 3/4  VIJU ABRAHAM , J.
 ===========================
 WP(C) No. 20017 of 2024  ============================
 Dated this the 4th day of June, 2024  ORDER The property of the petitioners shall not be taken possession without undergoing the procedure as per The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
Respondents seek time to get instructions.
